items.claim: Ian Garry has great balance, pushes and pulls, and can fight forward, backward, and laterally on his feet.
items.quote: what I like most about his style is his balance and the way that he pushes and pulls and he can fight forward and backwards and laterally on his feet

items.claim: Islam Makhachev uses top jiu-jitsu black belt pressure and wrestling to wear opponents out from the top position.
items.quote: What makes a Makhachev so important in his style to me is his top jiu-jitsu black belt pressure. This stuff. It's like he's not just a wrestler... he uses his wrestling to get to the top position and he wears you out.

items.claim: Ian Garry successfully defended against Belal Muhammad's wrestling attempts by using underhooks and spinning off the fence.
items.quote: Belal tried to wrestle decidedly in the fight... and he said, 'No, sir. No, sir. I will overhook, underhook you, and dance off the fence.'

items.claim: Islam Makhachev is moving up in weight from 155 pounds to 170 pounds.
items.quote: Islam Makhachev while an excellent wrestler... he's a 155er going up to 170.
